_doc: The third-person combat stance, one profile per class of gun (the owner, 2026-11-23: a confident, aggressive, disciplined military combat stance; never a pose per gun). Read at runtime (SOStance.h). families: a gun's family (game_data.json archetypes' family) -> its class. combatSeconds: how long the gun stays up after the last shot, aim, reload or hit; raiseTime / lowerTime: how fast it comes up from relaxed and goes back down. Per class. The gun: readyShift / aimShift (cm, actor axes forward, right, up): where a long gun's butt rides in the right shoulder pocket at the ready and on the sights; readyDip: the muzzle's dip at the ready (deg); handHold / handAimHold: a handgun's grip from the shoulders' middle (cm); relaxOffset / relaxRot: the relaxed carry (the owner, 2026-11-23: the gun seen from the eyes idle and walking): the gun at the ready turned by relaxRot (pitch, yaw, roll in the body's facing: the muzzle down and turned in) about a point between the firing hand's place on it (relaxPivot 0, the default) and the support hand's (1: a launcher's fore end is so far out that turned about the firing hand it left the support arm's reach), and moved by relaxOffset (cm, forward, right, up); relaxReach: relaxed, the gun comes in until the support hand is within this share of its arm (the arms easy; none = as at the ready). The arms [firing, support]: elbowSwing / elbowSwingAim: where each elbow is carried at the ready and on the sights, a swing round the line from its shoulder to its wrist (radians from straight down, + out round the arm's outside: out at the sides, seen from behind); wristShare: how much of the way from there toward the straightest wrist it goes; elbowLeast / elbowMost: the least and the most it may swing; wristMax: each elbow comes no further out than leaves its wrist within this (deg between forearm and hand); shoulders [ready, aim]: how much of the collarbones' forward pull is taken out (0..1: square shoulders, open chest). The trunk: blade / lean [ready, aim]: turned to the gun and leaning forward (deg; the head stays on the target); hips [relaxed, ready]: the hips turned, the support hip forward (deg); headDown: the chin down (deg). The legs [relaxed, ready]: knees: the hips lowered (cm); stagger: the support foot ahead of the firing foot standing (cm); width: the feet further apart than the clip stands them (cm); toeOut [support foot, firing foot] at the ready (deg, relaxed 40 % of it); kneeOut: the knees carried out over the toes (cm), never in. turnStep: standing at the ready, the feet step round under an aim that turned this far (deg).
